content:
For Apple users, managing digital files often feels like a constant battle against storage limits and recurring subscription fees. High-resolution photos, 4K videos, and massive project files add up quickly.

While monthly subscriptions might seem manageable at first, they add up significantly over the years. pCloud offers a radically different approach: a robust, secure cloud storage platform you pay for once and keep for life.

Right now, pCloud is running a special Family Day promotion. From May 11 through May 24, you can get up to 65% off a Family Lifetime Plan. Better yet, the deal includes pCloud Encryption completely free for life.

The Family Plan can be purchased and shared by any group of up to five users, whether friends, students, colleagues, or anyone you consider family. If you want to protect your family’s digital footprint without the hassle of ongoing payments, now is the perfect time to make the switch.

Seamless integration with the Apple ecosystem

Trusted by over 22 million users worldwide, pCloud is engineered to work effortlessly alongside your favorite Apple devices.

The dedicated desktop application, pCloud Drive, is available for macOS and functions as a secure virtual drive.

It extends your Mac’s storage without consuming physical hard drive space, allowing you to access, edit, and save files directly in the cloud as if they were stored locally.

On mobile, the smart pCloud app for iOS ensures your files are always with you.

Whether you are running the latest iOS 26 on your iPhone or switching over to an iPad, the app features automatic background uploads to instantly free up local storage space.

Everything syncs in real time across macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, and Android, meaning your workflow is never interrupted.

Designed for the whole family

A pCloud Family plan offers far more than a large pool of shared storage. With a single lifetime payment, it covers up to five members, whether they are family, friends, or colleagues.

Each member receives their own individual account and private storage space. Your personal files remain entirely yours, and you only share what you explicitly choose to share.

This makes collaboration incredibly seamless. You can effortlessly share files with family members, including non-pCloud users, through custom shared links, direct folder invitations, and file requests.

Smart media management

For families with massive photo libraries, pCloud Photos is a game-changer.

The platform automatically organizes all your uploaded images by date into a smart gallery with an intuitive timeline.

You can instantly jump back to specific years, browse your memories seamlessly, and customize your gallery by excluding certain folders.

pCloud also features a powerful built-in photo editor. You can apply professional tools like one-click filters, brightness and contrast adjustments, and highlight controls, or simply crop and rotate images directly in the cloud with real-time previews.

For video and music libraries, pCloud includes an integrated media player so you can stream your audio and video files or create playlists directly from the cloud without downloading the files first.

Swiss security and free client-side encryption

As a Swiss-based company, pCloud adheres to some of the strictest data privacy laws in the world, giving you complete control over your data across their US and Luxembourg data centers.

During this Family Day promotion, pCloud is including pCloud Encryption for free. This privacy-focused feature normally costs extra and provides client-side, zero-knowledge encryption for your most sensitive data.

Your confidential files are encrypted on your device before they ever reach pCloud’s servers, ensuring that only you, as the holder of the encryption key, can access them.

Pricing and availability

The pCloud Family Day promotion runs strictly from May 11 to May 24, 2026.

With zero recurring fees and lifetime access, these discounted bundles offer massive long-term savings:

  • 2 TB Family Lifetime Plan + FREE pCloud Encryption Lifetime: $449 (reg. $1,119) [60% off]
  • 5 TB Family Lifetime Plan + FREE pCloud Encryption Lifetime: $599 (reg. $1,698) [65% off]
  • 10 TB Family Lifetime Plan + FREE pCloud Encryption Lifetime: $1,099 (reg. $2,478) [56% off]

Take control of your family’s digital storage and protect your most sensitive files forever with pCloud.
